review_notes: I read the whole file. I searched Mathlib for competing versions of the quotient transition map. I found only `QuotientGroup.map` and `QuotientGroup.quotientMapOfLE` (Mathlib/GroupTheory/Coset/Basic.lean). Neither is a bundled continuous monoid hom, and `quotientTransitionHom` is implemented directly with `QuotientGroup.map`, so it is a named continuous-hom specialisation rather than a competitor. Mathlib has no `quotientInvariants`-style TopRep construction, no continuous-hom bundling of quotient maps, and no cochain-map transition lemmas for continuous cohomology. The `quotientTransition` in profinite-groups/ProfiniteGroups/FiniteQuotientHom.lean is a separate project library, not Mathlib. It is an unbundled `→*` wrapper over the same `QuotientGroup.map`, and the continuous version here adds topology. I did not judge that overlap a clear consolidation case. The remaining declarations are file-specific lemmas about `cochainsMap`/`map`; reproving them would be theorem duplication, which the rubric excludes. I found nothing to report.
